displayName.description: The name displayed on Availity Essentials for the payer.

name.description: The common name identifying the health plan.

payerId.description: The unique identifier used to communicate with the payer from Availity.

processingRoutes.description: A list of the routes available for communication from Availity to the payer.

additionalInfo.description: Additional information about the transaction if any.
additionalInfo.example: The 270 requires a GS02 value of LLX1210001. The 276 requires a GS02 value of LCX1210000.

availability.description: Indicates whether the transaction is available to the organization under their current contract or requires an additional Availity contract. Note this refers to the Availity contract not the payer.

effectiveDate.description: The date the transaction became available.

enrollmentMode.description: Indicates what type of enrollment is required with Availity(ex. Paper enrollment mode indicates additional paperwork must be submitted to the payer to complete the enrollment process).

enrollmentRequired.description: Indicates whether enrollment with Availity is required in order to submit the transaction.

gateway.description: The designation if Availity is the gateway for this payer for this route.

newTierNotice.description: Notice of upcoming tier change if applicable.

passThroughRate.description: The pass through rate for the route.

rebateTier.description: The cost tier for the route.

recentlyAdded.description: The date the route was added.

submissionMode.description: Describes how the data is submitted to Availity(ex. Portal, Batch).

shortName.description: A shortened name for the payer used in the file naming convention for batch transactions.
